author: MeijiHKitty
body:
A use case for the mask, even though it’s a T6 item and you are T10, is if you are using the Blade of Finesse/Swashbuckler spec since the gear provides 0 Def. The two handed bonus is nice as well

Can also use it on your Default equipment setup for the +20% View Distance

You’ll find that as a T10/11 you will actually end up keeping/using gear from lower tiers due to immunities, bonuses, or some fun gimmick they provide, so don’t write things off as useless just because it’s lower tiered. It just depends on what build/play style you use and what they provide/bring to the table

author: takennamer
body:
This bonus, afaik, gets calculated before other bonuses, so just atop of base stats, so it's not as significant as 2h bonus for example. 
41% is a lot tho and if you are low-ish AL it would be significant enough to justify giving up the pet for it imo.
